y-m-83-07.title: Ripoti rinoti mutemo une mikana mishoma ndiwo wakachengeteka zvikuru
y-m-83-07.goal: Tsvaga kukanganisa muripoti iine kuverenga kwakarurama asi mhedziso yakanganisa, gadzira mitemo inosangana namamiriro iwe pachako, uye utonge pfungwa inodikanwa kutaura nezvomukana uchishandisa huwandu hwemikana.
y-m-83-07.material: Tinoda kusarudza mutemo wenhamba yetsvina yelokeri yekirabhu. Nhamba ine mazinga 4, uye nzvimbo yega yega inoshandisa imwe yenhamba 0 kusvika 9. Mutemo R1 unobvumira nhamba imwe chete kushandiswa kakawanda, R2 unoda kuti mazinga ose mana ave akasiyana, uye R3 unobvumira nhamba imwe chete kushandiswa asi nhamba yekutanga haifaniri kuva 0. Mudzidzi akanyora chikamu cheripoti inoenzanisa mitemo nokuverenga nhamba dzinogoneka pasi pemutemo wega wega. Nzira inosarudzwa nayo nhamba haisati yasarudzwa.
y-m-83-07.thinking.0: Kucherechedza kuti mhedziso inogona kukanganisa kunyange kuverenga kwakarurama
y-m-83-07.prereq.0: Pfungwa yenhevedzano yechikoro: iri ibasa rokuongorora rinoshandiswa mushure mokudzidza kuverenga (mutemo wechakawanikwa, permutation) nepfungwa dzokutanga dzomukana. 'H3' chiratidzo chenhanho yokuoma yeboka rokugadzira chete, kwete kugoverwa kwegiredhi.
y-m-83-07.prereq.2: Pfungwa yokuti kana nyaya dzinogoneka dzine mukana wakaenzana, mukana ndi 1/(huwandu hwenyaya)
y-m-83-07.s.s1.prompt: Iri ripoti rinoenzanisa mitemo yenhamba yetsvina yelokeri yekirabhu (mazinga 4) nehuwandu hwemikana. Sarudza mutsetse mumwe umo kufunga kusingawirirani. (Nhamba dzemitsetse dzinoratidzwa kubva pa 1 pascreen.)
y-m-83-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kumutemo wega wega, taura nemashoko kuti pane nhamba dzingani dzokusarudza kana ukasarudza nhamba imwe uye ukaedza kuifungidzira.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti mukana wokufungidzira unosiyana sei kana ukasarudza nhamba ipi neipi kana pane mikana 5040 nekana 10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.0: Mutemo R1 (nhamba imwe chete inogona kushandiswa kakawanda): nzvimbo yega yega inogona kushandisa chero ipi ye 0 kusvika 9, saka pane mikana 10×10×10×10 = 10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.1: Mutemo R2 (nhamba dzose ina dzakasiyana): 10 yeyekutanga, 9 yechipiri, 8 yechitatu, 7 yechina, saka 10×9×8×7 = 5040 mikana.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.2: Mutemo R3 (nhamba imwe chete inobvumirwa asi nzvimbo yekutanga haisi 0): 9 yeyekutanga uye 10 yega yega yedzimwe, saka 9×10×10×10 = 9000 mikana.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.3: Saka huwandu hwemikana ndi R2 < R3 < R1. R2, ine mikana mishoma, ndiyo yakachengeteka zvikuru.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.4: Saka kushandisa mutemo usingabvumiri nhamba dzakadzokororwa kunoita kuti nhamba ive yakachengeteka zvakanyanya.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.explain: Kuverenga mikana mumitsetse 1 kusvika 3 (10000, 5040, 9000) kwakarurama. Asi mutsetse 4 wakati mutemo une mikana mishoma ndiwo wakachengeteka zvikuru. Kana mumwe munhu achiedza kufungidzira nhamba nokusarudza, nhamba dzinogoneka dzakawanda, zvinoita kuti zvive zvakaoma kufungidzira. Mutsetse 5 mhedziso inobva pakukanganisa kumwe chete.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino, gadzira mutemo wetsvina iwe pachako. Huwandu hwemakodhi anogoneka hunofanira kuva 1,000,000 kana kupfuura, uye kuti zvive nyore kuyeuka, kureba ndi 5 kana pasi. Huwandu hwemarudzi ezviratidzo zvaunogona kushandisa, k, ndi imwe ye 10 (nhamba chete), 26 (mavara madiki echiRungu chete), 36 (nhamba + mavara madiki echiRungu), kana 62 (nhamba + mavara echiRungu emakesi ose mbiri), uye chiratidzo chimwe chete chinogona kushandiswa kakawanda. Tsvaga (k, n) 3 dzakasiyana dzinosangana namamiriro.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza k ne n rimwe panguva imwe uye uverenge kuti pane makodhi anogoneka mangani. Tarisa kana kune dzimwe k kunyange n yakaenzana ne 5 isingakwani.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ita n ive 4 ne 5 uye uenzanise kuti k inofanira kuva huru zvakadini kuti ipfuure mamiriro.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Kureba inhamba yechisikigo kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 5.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kureba n kunofanira kuva nhamba yechisikigo kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 5.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Huwandu hwemakodhi anogoneka (k yakawanzwa nguva n) huri pasi pe 1,000,000.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.explain: Nyaya dzine k^n≥1,000,000 ndi (26, 5)=11,881,376, (36, 4)=1,679,616, (36, 5), (62, 4), (62, 5). Nenhamba chete (k=10), n=5 inopa mikana 100,000 chete, saka kureba kwe 6 kwaizodikanwa, uye mavara madiki echiRungu 4 (26⁴=456,976) haakwanawo.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.prompt: Unoda kutaura kuti 'pasi pemutemo R1, mukana wokufungidzira nhamba nokusarudza kamwe ndi 1/10000.' Kuti chirevo ichi chishande, pfungwa ipi inodikanwa pazvinotevera?
y-m-83-07.s.s3.hint.0: Funga pahupenyu chaihwo kana nhamba dzose 10000 dzinogoneka dzaizoshandiswa nenguva dzakafanana.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.hint.1: Tsvaga pakashandiswa pfungwa ye 'mukana wakaenzana' mukuverenga kunopa mukana we 1/10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.a: Nhamba inofanira kuva iri nyore kuyeuka, se 1234, uye isingadzokororwi.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.a: Nhamba dzakareruka kuyeuka ndidzo chaidzo vanhu vanoedza kutanga. Zvinogona kuita kuti zviwanikwe nyore kufungidzira.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.b: Munhu anoedza kufungidzira anofanira kunge atoedza kamwe kana kaviri otadza.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.b: Kana vatoedza kana kwete haisi mukana wokuedza kwekutanga. Tsvaga kuti mukana 1/10000 ndiwo mukana wei.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.c: Nhamba 10000 dzinosarudzwa nomukana wakaenzana, uye munhu anofungidzira anoziva mutemo.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.c: Unoziva kuti kuti mukana uve 'reshiyo yakapesana yehuwandu hwemikana,' pfungwa inodikanwa yokuti nyaya dzinogoneka dzine mukana wakaenzana.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.d: Mutemo unofanira kuchinjwa kuva se R2 usingabvumiri nhamba dzakadzokororwa.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.d: Mamiriro aya haana chokuita nokuti mutemo R1 chii. Kana ukachinja R1 kuva R2, huwandu hwemikana pachahwo hunochinja.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.explain: Kuti reshiyo yakapesana yehuwandu hwemikana ive mukana, unoda pfungwa yokuti nhamba dzinogoneka dzinosarudzwa nomukana wakaenzana. Kana vanhu vachisarudza zvakawanda mazuva okuzvarwa kana 1234, mukana chaiwo wokufungidzira unogona kuva wakakwirira kupfuura uyu. Huwandu hwemikana hwehwaro hwimwe chete hwokuchengetedzeka.

y-m-83-02.title: Mapoinzi 100 anogona kusiyanisa 3.12 ne 3.14 here?
y-m-83-02.goal: Mureport yakafungidzira π nekuisa mapoinzi zvisina kurongeka, wana kwairatidza zvirevo zvakasimba zvakanyanya, taura miganhu yemhedziso zvichibva pakupararira kwemhedzisiro dzakadzokororwa, uye udhiziine iwe pachako ongororo inovimbika zvakawanda.
y-m-83-02.material: Tinoda kufungidzira mutengo we pi (π) nesimulation. Pa coordinate plane, komputa inoisa mapoinzi zvakaenzana zvisina kurongeka mukati me square ine 0 ≤ x ≤ 1 ne 0 ≤ y ≤ 1 (divi refu 1). Kana x² + y² < 1 (x squared pamwe ne y squared i shoma kupfuura 1), poinzi i mukati me quarter circle ye radius 1. Area ye quarter circle i π/4 uye area ye square i 1, saka mukana wekuti poinzi iwire mukati me quarter circle i π/4. Boka rimwe rakaisa mapoinzi 100 uye rakanyora report.
y-m-83-02.prereq.0: Fungidziro yekurongeka kwechikoro: iri i basa rekuongorora rinoshandiswa mushure mekudzidza yuniti ye probability (mukana unowanikwa ne area, kudzokorora miedzo). 'H3' i label yedanho rekunetsa rebatch yekugadzira chete, kwete kugoverwa kwegiredhi.
y-m-83-02.prereq.1: Fomula ye area yedenderedzwa nezvinoreva quarter circle
y-m-83-02.prereq.2: Pfungwa yekuti mukana i ratio yema areas (fomula ye standard deviation haidiwi)
y-m-83-02.s.s1.prompt: Iyi i chikamu chereport yakanyorwa neboka rimwe. Sarudza mutsetse mumwe apo humbowo husina kukwana mumaitiro ekusvika pamhedziso. (Nhamba dzemitsetse dzinoratidzwa pascreen dzichitanga ne 1.)
y-m-83-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ronga mutsetse wega wega kuita 'zvakacherechedzwa,' 'zvakaverengwa,' kana 'zvakasarudzwa semhedziso.'
y-m-83-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kana waita ongororo imwechete kamwe zvakare, funga kana 78 ichabuda zvakare chaizvo.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.0: Mapoinzi 100 akaiswa zvisina kurongeka mukati me square.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.1: Pakati pawo, mapoinzi ane x² + y² < 1, ndiko kuti, mapoinzi ari mukati me quarter circle, aiva 78.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.2: Mukana wekuti poinzi iwire mukati me quarter circle i area ratio π/4, saka tinogona kutaura 78/100 ≈ π/4.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.4: Saka π i 3.12, uye iyi i shoma kupfuura 3.14.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.5: Kana tikawedzera mapoinzi kusvika ku 1000, mhedzisiro ichava padyo ne 3.14 zvechokwadi.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse we5 wakazivisa fungidziro 3.12 kubva pamapoinzi 100 sekunge mutengo we π, uye mutsetse we6 wakazivisa kuti kuwedzera mapoinzi 'zvechokwadi' kuchaswedera padyo. Ongororo isina kurongeka inopa mhedzisiro yakasiyana kunyange kana ukaiita nenzira imwechete zvakare, uye nemapoinzi akawanda kupararira kunowanzodzikira, asi hapana chivimbiso chekuti mhedzisiro imwe i padyo. Matanho emitsetse 1 kusvika 4 (ratio → π/4 → ka4) anogona kushandiswa sezvawo.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.prompt: Mapoka mashanu imwe neimwe yakaisa mapoinzi 100 nenzira imwechete uye yakaverenga mapoinzi ari mukati me quarter circle, ichiwana 78, 81, 74, 80, ne 77. Fungidziro 4×(huwandu hwemapoinzi)/100 i 3.12, 3.24, 2.96, 3.20, 3.08, uye avhareji i 3.12. Unoona sei chirevo che 'ongororo iyi inotiudza kuti π i shoma kupfuura 3.14'?
y-m-83-02.s.s2.hint.0: Wana musiyano pakati pe diki zvikuru neyakakura zvikuru yefungidziro shanu.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.hint.1: Isa musiyano uyu padivi pemusiyano pakati pe 3.14 ne 3.12 uye uvaenzanise.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.o.a: 3.12 i mutengo uri padyo zvikuru ne 3.14, saka boka rakawana mutengo uyu rakaita ongororo yakarurama zvikuru.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.a: Izvi hazvisiyanise mhedzisiro imwe iri padyo nenjodzi nenzira kuva yakarurama. Tarisa kuti mitengo yakadzokororwa nenzira imwechete yakapararira sei.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.o.b: Avhareji yemhedzisiro shanu i 3.12, saka tinogona kutonga kuti π i 3.12 uye shoma kupfuura 3.14.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.b: Kutora avhareji kunoderedza kupararira, asi mapoinzi 500 achiri asina kukwana kusiyanisa musiyano we 0.02 pakati pe 3.12 ne 3.14. Gadzirisa kuti unovimba neavhareji zvakadini.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.o.c: Mhedzisiro dzakapararira kubva ku 2.96 kusvika ku 3.24, saka nemapoinzi 100 haugone kutaura chinhu nezve musiyano pakati pe 3.12 ne 3.14.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.c: Wakaenzanisa kupararira kwemhedzisiro dzakadzokororwa (0.28) nemusiyano waunoda kuziva (0.02), uye wakaona kuti kupararira kukuru zvikuru.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.o.d: Mhedzisiro yeboka rega rega inobuda yakasiyana, saka ongororo iyi haigone kutiudza chinhu nezve π.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.d: Wakaverenga mhedzisiro kusiyana sekureva kuti ongororo haina basa. Kana uchiziva kuti kupararira kwakakura zvakadini, unogona kutaura kuti π i anenge 3.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.explain: Mhedzisiro shanu dzinobva ku 2.96 kusvika ku 3.24, dzakapararira anenge 0.28. Musiyano watinoda kuwana, 0.02, i mudiki zvikuru kupfuura kupararira uku. Saka ongororo iyi haigone kutaura kuti 3.12 kana 3.14 ndiyo yakarurama, uye inogona kutaura chete kuti π i anenge 3.
y-m-83-02.s.s3.prompt: Ikozvino dhiziine ongororo imwechete ye quarter circle kuti iite inovimbika zvakawanda. Sarudza huwandu hwemapoinzi nehwekudzokorora senhamba, uye unyore mumashoko 2 kusvika 3 kuti mhedziso yeongororo iyoyo inogona kusvika pakutaura chii.
y-m-83-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti unodzidza chii nekuita ongororo imwechete kakawanda, sezvakaitwa nemhedzisiro dzemapoka mashanu.
y-m-83-02.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti chii chinochinja kana wawedzera huwandu hwemapoinzi nekana wawedzera huwandu hwekudzokorora.

y-m-83-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakati uchanyora chii kana mhedzisiro dzisingagone kusiyanisa 3.12 ne 3.14?
y-m-83-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Pachinzvimbo che 'chakarurama,' wakataura muganhu, sa 'mukati merange iyi' here?
y-m-83-02.s.s3.model.0: Boka rega rega rinodzokorora ongororo yekuisa mapoinzi 1000 ka5. Tinotarisa kuti fungidziro 5 dzakapararira mu range ipi, uye kana zvose 3.12 ne 3.14 zviri mukati merange iyoyo, hatizotaura kuti ndeipi iri padyo.
y-m-83-02.s.s3.model.1: Isa mapoinzi 400 panguva imwe uye udzokorore ka10 kuwana fungidziro 10. Kana huwandu hwemapoinzi hwakakura ka4, tinotarisira kuti kupararira kudzikire kusvika pahafu. Kunyange zvakadaro, kana mhedzisiro dzichiri kusiyana, tinozvitora sekukanganisa uye hatizivise kuti i shoma kupfuura 3.14.
y-m-83-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ndakataura hukama pakati pehuwandu hwemapoinzi nekupararira sechinotarisirwa.

y-m-83-04.title: Kana ratio yakabatanidzwa nema ratios akapatsanurwa zvichitaura zvinhu zvakasiyana
y-m-83-04.goal: Kana ratio yakabatanidzwa nema ratios nechishandiso zvichiratidza nzira dzakasiyana, tarisa kana mamiriro ekuenzanisa akafanana, gadzirisa kutonga kwako nekuvimba, uye utsanangure chikonzero nenhamba.
y-m-83-04.material: App yeraibhurari yechikoro yakaratidza mutsetse wekurudzira A ne B nenhevedzano uye yakanyora ma clicks. Kuti mutsetse upi wakaratidzwa kuvashandisi vechishandiso chipi (mobile kana PC) kwakasarudzwa ne app, kwete kuiswa zvisina kurongeka nevadzidzi. Data rinoratidzwa danho rimwe panguva, uye padanho rimwe nerimwe unotonga kuti mutsetse upi unowana ma clicks akawanda.
y-m-83-04.thinking.0: Kuverenga denominator ne numerator ye ratio
y-m-83-04.prereq.0: Fungidziro yekurongeka kwechikoro: iri rinoonekwa sebasa rekubvunza rinoshandiswa mushure mekudzidza ma ratios ne conditional ratios mu probability ne statistics. 'H3' inongova label yenhanho yekuoma yeboka rekugadzira, kwete kugoverwa kwegiredhi.
y-m-83-04.prereq.1: Kutsvaga nekuenzanisa ma ratios nema fractions nema percentages
y-m-83-04.prereq.2: Pfungwa yekuti saizi ye sample inokanganisa sei kuti ratio inogona kuvimbwa zvakadii
y-m-83-04.s.s1.prompt: Data yekuziva kuti ndeipi yemashoko ekukurudzira e app ye library yechikoro, A kana B, inowana ma clicks akawanda inoratidzwa mumadanho. Padanho rimwe nerimwe, sarudza kutonga kwako, uye ufunge kana kutonga kwako kana chivimbo chako zvichichinja kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda. Kuchengeta kutonga kwako zvakanakawo, kana uine umboo.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda, tanga watarisa kana mapoka maviri anoenzaniswa ari 'mumamiriro akafanana.'
y-m-83-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora zvakaparadzana denominator (huwandu hwenguva dzakaratidzwa) ne numerator (huwandu hwema clicks) yeratio imwe neimwe uye uenzanise.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Mumwedzi miviri app yakaratidza mashoko A ne B ka120 rimwe nerimwe. A yakawana ma clicks 32 uye B yakawana 58.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Neruzivo urwu oga, shoko ripi rinonzwisisika kutaura kuti rinowana ma clicks akawanda?
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Zvatinogona kutaura zvino zvinoenda chete kusvika ku 'mumwedzi miviri iyi, click ratio ye B yaiva yakakwirira.' Hatisati taziva nei, kana kuti nekuda kweshoko here.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Rimwe nerimwe rakaratidzwa ka120, uye click ratio inenge 48% kune B uye inenge 27% kune A, saka parizvino ndinoti B yakawana ma clicks akawanda.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakaenzanisa huwandu hwema clicks pahuwandu hwakafanana hwenguva dzakaratidzwa, uye uri kushandisa fungidziro yekuti zvinoenzaniswa zviri mumamiriro akafanana.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: 32 ya A yakaderera pane 58 ye B, saka hatigoni kutaura kuti A yakawana ma clicks akawanda, asi hatisarudzi kuti ndeipi iri nani.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kunyange mhedzisiro dzakasiyana, uri kumira kutonga. Taura kuti chikonzero chekumira chii.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 32 ne58 pakati pe120 dzakasiyana zvikuru, saka hapana mukana zvachose kuti ndeye mukana, uye zvakanyatsojeka kuti B ndiro shoko rakanaka.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakaona musiyano mukuru sezvakafanana ne 'zvakanyatsojeka.' Tichiri kusaziva kana vanhu vakaratidzwa mashoko maviri vaiva mumamiriro akafanana.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Huwandu hwenguva hwakafanana, saka ma clicks anofanira kubuda akafananawo, uye musiyano wakadaro wakamuka nekuti rekodhi yakashata.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wakafunga kuti data yakashata nekuti mhedzisiro yaisiyana nezvaitarisirwa. Une chikonzero chakaparadzana chekuvhunduka data here?
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Kuiparadzanisa nechinhu chakashandiswa kupinda, zvakaita sezvizvi. Mobile: A yakawana ma clicks 12 pakati pe20, B yakawana ma clicks 55 pakati pe100. PC: A yakawana ma clicks 20 pakati pe100, B yakawana ma clicks 3 pakati pe20.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Taura kutonga kwako zvakare mushure mekuona mhedzisiro nechinhu.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana yaparadzaniswa, click ratio ye A iri pamusoro pazvinhu zvose zviviri, kunyange B iri pamberi mumakosha akabatanidzwa. Izvi zvinogona kuitika kana click ratio inosiyana nechinhu uye chikamu chezvinhu umo mashoko maviri akaratidzwa chakasiyana.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Click ratio yose yaiva yakakwirira kune B, saka ndinochengeta kutonga kwekuti B iri nani uye ndinotora nhamba dzechinhu serereferensi chete.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kunyange kana ratio yose yakarurama, hauna kutarisa kana nhamba dzakabatanidzwa dzichienzanisa mashoko maviri zvakarurama. Isa ma ratios echinhu padivi pemumwe.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mobile A 60%, B 55%, PC A 20%, B 15%, saka ndinochinja kutonga kwangu kuti nditaure kuti A iri pamberi pakati pezvinhu zvakafanana.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakabata kuti mhedzisiro yakabatanidzwa neyakaparadzaniswa zvinoratidza nzira dzakasiyana, uye wakasarudza kuenzanisa pasi pemamiriro akafanana.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Pane maseru ane ma samples madiki zvakare, senge mobile A ne20, saka ndinoti ndinorerekera kuti A iri nani asi handina chivimbo chakawanda.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Unotevera nzira yemhedzisiro nechinhu uchitauramo kusava nechokwadi apo sample iri diki.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kuparadzanisa nechinhu kunoita kuti nhamba dziite dzakaoma zvikuru, saka ratio yose, yakapfupiswa munhamba imwe, inovimbika zvakanyanya.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakadzikisa ruzivo nekuti rwakaoma. Ona kuti chii chinonyangarika kana wadzikisa.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Kutarisa kuti mashoko akaratidzwa sei, A yakaratidzwa ka100 pakati pe120 kuvashandisi vePC, uye B yakaratidzwa ka100 pakati pe120 kuvashandisi vemobile. Kubatanidza mashoko maviri, click ratio pa mobile inenge 56% (67 pakati pe120) uye pa PC inenge 19% (23 pakati pe120).
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kana waziva ruzivo urwu, kutonga kupi kunonzwisisika?
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Dai vakaratidzwa nezvikamu zvakafanana, kuenzanisa neratio yakabatanidzwa kwaisazova kure munzira. Waigona kuchengeta kutonga kwako kwekutanga kana kuchichinja, asi chinokosha ndechekuti ruzivo rupi rwakazunza kutonga kwako.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: B iri pamusoro muratio yakabatanidzwa, saka kuramba uchishandisa B kwakarurama, uye handichinji kutonga kwangu kwekutanga.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ratio yakabatanidzwa kuva yakakwirira hapana kuti yaizobva kushoko B asi nekuti B yakaratidzwa zvakawanda pa mobile, apo pane ma clicks akawanda.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Chinhu chine simba guru pama clicks, saka mashoko akanga asina simba zvachose kubva pakutanga.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Simba guru rechinhu harina kutungamira kumhedziso yekuti shoko haribatsiri. Unofanirawo kutsanangura kuti nei A yaiva pamberi mukati mechinhu chimwe nechimwe.

y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakagadzirisa kutonga kwako zvichibva pakusaenzana kwekuratidza, uye wakagadzirisa chivimbo chako nekuti maseru mamwe ane ma samples madiki.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ndinokurudzira kuita experiment zvakare kuti shoko rega rega riratidzwe nechikamu chakafanana pazvinhu zvose, wozoenzanisa mushure.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Zvichibva pamiganhu ye data yazvino, wakakurudzira nzira yakarurama yekuenzanisa.

y-m-83-05.title: Tinogona kutaura here kuti kuwedzera kwemwedzi ne compounding ndi6% pagore nekuti '0.5 kuwedzera ka12'?
y-m-83-05.topic: Kuenzanisa Interest Models nekutonga Ruzivo Runodiwa
y-m-83-05.goal: Edza nenhamba chirevo chinoenzanisa monthly compound interest ne annual simple interest, rongedza ruzivo rwunodiwa kutaura mhedziso, uye utsvage uye utsanangure iwe pachako kuti musiyano unochinja sei nenguva.
y-m-83-05.material: Mudzidzi akaona kushambadzira kwebhanga akati, 'Compound deposit inowedzera 0.5% interest mwedzi wega wega ndi 0.5×12=6, saka yakafanana ne deposit ye6% simple interest pagore.' Ne compound interest, interest yemwedzi wega wega inowedzerwa ku principal kuverenga interest yemwedzi unotevera, uye ne simple interest, interest inoverengwa pa principal yekutanga chete. Mubasa iri, fungidzira kuti hapana taxes kana fees.
y-m-83-05.prereq.0: Fungidziro yekurongeka kwechikoro: iri rinoonekwa sebasa rekubvunza rinoshandiswa mushure mekudzidza general term ye sequence (geometric sequence) nekuverenga powers. 'H3' inongova label yenhanho yekuoma yeboka rekugadzira, kwete kugoverwa kwegiredhi.

y-m-83-05.s.s1.o.a: Verenga zvakare kuti utarise kuti kuwedzera 0.5% ka12 kunoita 6%.
y-m-83-05.s.s1.r.a: Mudzidzi atoita kuverenga uku. Mubvunzo ndewekuti compound interest inokura nenzira imwe chete nekuverenga uku here.
y-m-83-05.s.s1.o.b: Sarudza huwandu hwemari nenguva, tsvaga huwandu hwema deposits maviri mushure memwedzi 12, uye uvaenzanise.
y-m-83-05.s.s1.r.b: Uku kufunga kunoshandura chirevo kuita nhamba chaidzo uye kunochiedza nekuisa mhedzisiro yenzira mbiri padivi pemumwe.

y-m-83-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakasarudza mhedziso kubva pakutenda kwevanhu. Kuti sei zvakasiyana, uye rinhi, zvinofanira kutariswa nekuverenga.

y-m-83-05.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kutaura 'mari yakawanda zvakadii (mu won) inowanikwa ne monthly 0.5% compound interest kupfuura 6% simple interest pagore.' Sarudza zvose zvaunofanira kuziva kubva pane zvinotevera.
